heading: Improperly influencing member of legislative body.
text: NRS 198.010 Improperly influencing member of legislative body. Every person who obtains or seeks to obtain money or other thing of value from another person upon a pretense, claim or representation that the person can or will improperly influence in any manner the action of any member of a legislative body in regard to any vote or legislative action, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. [1911 C&P § 53; RL § 6318; NCL § 10002]—(NRS A 1967, 463 )
